strongest_results: In the inherited high-Q critical layer, a source-sensitive dichotomy gives either one failed slot charged by n^(1/5-o(1)) distinct high-order source faces or a dense bounded-order common star.

The bounded-order branch is rigorously excluded: DRC and Ramsey produce three linearly independent pairwise irrational normals; a coefficient-uniform bounded-degree torsion-closure theorem forces a positive-dimensional torsion coset; an explicit one-parameter real-unit-sphere argument rules every such coset out.

The surviving high-order branch yields a two-coordinate repair star, global repair graphs with n^(2-o(1)) edges and n^(3-o(1)) clean marks, and a three-source cross-kernel of n^(4/5-o(1)) Q-rich faces.

The cross-kernel synchronizes a common reference pattern whose size tends slowly to infinity across n^(4/5-o(1)) reflecting faces. Its point-plane incidence count exactly saturates the n^(7/5-o(1)) Rudnev main term; ordinary KST/DRC and second/third incidence moments are quantitatively too weak.
results.remaining_gap: Prove a source-sensitive incidence or capacity saving for the high-order failed-slot/cross-kernel structure. Separately, the Round10 low-Q weighted (q_pi,g_pi) branch remains unresolved and was not closed by this workflow.

strongest_results: A joint alteration theorem converts H5 and H6 power savings into rainbow exponent min(1/3,(1+epsilon_5)/4,(1+epsilon_6)/5); unconditionally it gives the known 1/4 route or a radius class with n^(7/4) triangles.
The H6 obstruction contains the general-position form of open Erdos problem #104. Inversion converts H5 exactly into fixed-center equal-distance collisions among spanned secants.
The exact identities E_inv=2C4+C5 and E_rad=C4+C5+C6 give a positive Bernstein-form sampling ledger, showing that no hidden cancellation removes either remaining energy bottleneck.
results.remaining_gap: Obtain a fixed power saving for the aggregate pinned inversion energy H5 and a power saving for the H6/#104 radius energy. Neither is supplied by existing single-center bounds.

publication_assessment.assessment: The #1083 low-order exclusion and high-order kernels are substantial components and sharper interfaces, but without a main-exponent improvement or closure they do not yet form a standalone SCI Q2 result. The #827 work is an exact reduction/barrier analysis rather than a new extremal bound.
